answers.purpose: Fetch a Confluence page by URL or page id as clean markdown (via the confluence/ hand tools) so the session can analyse it - summarise, review, extract, compare.

triggers.disambiguation: Read-only, Confluence-to-session direction. Distinct from confluence-publish (session-to-Confluence: builds and publishes docs pages; its NOT-for clause points ad-hoc reads here). Distinct from jira (tickets, not pages). Not for pages whose markdown source lives in trade-imports-documentation - read the source file directly instead.
